newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Sept 16.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Sept 16.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- 500 Saudi Arabian companies face piracy on the internet. Saudi public relations company to take legal action to protect the firms.
- Saudi Arabia plans to build two quarantine units in Jeddah for imported sheep.
- Saudi Arabian delegation to visit South Africa to attend the African Travel Market to be held in Johannesburg from September 19.
- A factory will be set up in Dammam to manufacture plastic pipes and fittings under a Saudi-Czech joint venture agreement singed recently.
